newsitem.title: USA: GF Bancorp Inc to file with SEC deregistration.
newsitem.headline: GF Bancorp Inc to file with SEC deregistration.

text.p: GF Bancorp Inc, the holding company for Germantown Federal Savings Bank, said Wednesday it would file a Form 15 certification and notice to terminate its registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
After the filing, GF will no longer be required to file periodic reports with the SEC, the company said.
At the end of August, GF had 292,958 common shares outstanding and about 200 shareholders of record.
The stock of is not traded on any exchange nor quoted on the Nasdaq, the company said.
